description_en: This API queries statistics information about Graphic Computing Service instances purchased by users, across various dimensions. You can use this API to obtain instance statistics information based on conditions such as Project ID (ProjectId), District ID (DistrictId), and Instance Type (InstanceType). The instance statistics information includes the number of instances in states such as creating, running, O&M, and releasing
description_zh:
此 API 旨在查询不同维度下，用户购买的云渲染实例统计信息。

用户可以通过此接口获取项目（ProjectId）、大区（DistrictId）和实例类型（InstanceType）等条件下的实例统计信息，

实例统计信息中包含: 创建中、运行中、运维中、释放中等状态的实例数量
kebab_example: aliyun cgcs describe-instance-stats-info --project-ids 6733705348307226241003 --instance-types gcs.r1c1m1.1xlarge --district-ids huabei --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceStatsInfo

parameters.help_en: List of project IDs. If left blank, all project IDs are included by default
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID列表，不填默认所有
parameters.name: project_ids

parameters.help_en: List of instance types. If left blank, all instance types are included by default
parameters.help_zh: 实例类型列表，不填默认所有
parameters.name: instance_types

parameters.help_en: List of District IDs. If left blank, all District IDs are included by default
parameters.help_zh: 大区ID列表，不填默认所有
parameters.name: district_ids
